title: from-vibecoding-to-sdd
content:
从 vibecoding 到 SDD关于 AI Coding 的一些思考和心得。
对于 vibecoding 的理解vibecoding 可以拆分为 vibe 与 coding 两词。vibe，译为“氛围”，因此 vibecoding 也通常被译为“氛围编程”，通常指的是使用 AI 来辅助编程从而提升效率、享受开发的过程。
较为极端的观点提倡完全使用 AI 进行全流程的项目开发，开发者仅使用 prompt 与 AI 助手进行交互而不直接手动编写代码；更广义上的观点则更多强调 AI 助手的介入与协作，对于开发者是否能手动编写代码并没有要求限制。
对于开发者来说，其实更多关注于如何使用 AI 助手来提高开发效率。至于如何实现高效地 AI 辅助，之前我更多思考如何优化 prompt 与 AI 助手的规则和上下文，但是归纳下来，其实核心在于优化从上到下的理念，即从整体到细节。
先说一下如何归纳出这一结论的：

对于 prompt 而言，一个优秀的 prompt 应尽可能多地包含有效信息以及输出范式。我们不妨模拟人类面对问题的思考过程，将 AI 的实际工作拆分为两步，即先理解问题的背景和需求，然后根据这些需求来设计解决方案。用户角色、任务背景、输入输出示例、输出要求等刚开始使用 AI 的人可能忽视的方面都是对于整体架构的有力补充。现阶段，如果不加中止规则，如“如果有不明确的需求请向我补充提问直至明确”，AI 一定会“完成”你 prompt 设定的任务， 也就是会“推测”并补全你的 prompt 与 context 缺失的部分。通常来说实现总是更好校验的，运行性上通过测试就行了，AI 最擅长的依旧是“1+1=2”这样有明确结果的问题的回答。而需求上则不想查字典那样简单，不够明确具体的需求显然更容易出现“推测”的补全从而需要人类再次对话矫正…

对于 AI 助手而言，一个优秀的助手应尽可能多地包含有效规则和上下文，比如代码规范、编码风格、项目架构等。…


SDDSDD，即“规格驱动开发”（Spec-Driven Development），是一种软件开发方法论，强调在开发过程中先定义好系统的规格和需求，然后根据这些规格和需求进行开发。与之类似的还有数据驱动开发（Data-Driven Development），强调在开发过程中先定义好系统的数据通信架构，然后根据这些数据进行开发。
我认为 SDD 是一种非常好的开发方法论，它可以帮助开发者更好地理解系统的需求和规格，从而更好地设计和实现系统。它也是非常贴合 AI Coding 的一种开发方法论，因为在 SDD 中，开发者需要先定义好系统的规格和需求，然后根据这些规格和需求来设计和实现系统。而在 AI Coding 中，开发者需要先定义好系统的 prompt，然后根据这些 prompt 来设计和实现系统。
我们要做的应该是让人类做人类擅长的事，让 AI 做它擅长的事。需求和规格文档理应由人类完成，在和很多同学同事沟通时，“懂业务”也是公认的人类体现优势与竞争力的地方。…

title: IndexedDB 完全指南与实践
content:
IndexedDB 完全指南与实践1. IndexedDB 简介IndexedDB 是一个运行在浏览器中的非关系型数据库,用于在客户端存储大量结构化数据(包括文件/二进制对象)。
核心特点
大容量存储:通常至少 50MB,最多可达数 GB(取决于浏览器和磁盘空间)
异步 API:不会阻塞主线程,适合存储大量数据
事务性:所有操作都在事务中进行,保证数据一致性
键值对存储:使用对象存储空间(Object Store),支持索引
同源策略:每个源(origin)有独立的数据库
持久化:数据长期保存,除非手动删除或清除浏览器数据

2. IndexedDB 基础操作打开数据库12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637383940414243444546474849505152535455565758596061function openDatabase(dbName, version) {  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {    const request = indexedDB.open(dbName, version);        // 数据库打开成功    request.onsuccess = (event) => {      console.log('数据库打开成功');      resolve(event.target.result);    };        // 数据库打开失败    request.onerror = (event) => {      console.error('数据库打开失败:', event.target.error);      reject(event.target.error);    };        // 数据库升级(首次创建或版本号变更)    request.onupgradeneeded = (event) => {      console.log('数据库升级中...');      const db = event.target.result;            // 创建对象存储空间      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('users')) {        const objectStore = db.createObjectStore('users', {           keyPath: 'id',          autoIncrement: true         });                // 创建索引        objectStore.createIndex('email', 'email', { unique: true });        objectStore.createIndex('name', 'name', { unique: false });        objectStore.createIndex('age', 'age', { unique: false });      }            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('posts')) {        const postStore = db.createObjectStore('posts', {           keyPath: 'id',          autoIncrement: true         });                postStore.createIndex('userId', 'userId', { unique: false });        postStore.createIndex('timestamp', 'timestamp', { unique: false });      }    };        // 数据库被阻塞(通常是其他标签页打开了旧版本)    request.onblocked = () => {      console.warn('数据库升级被阻塞,请关闭其他标签页');    };  });}// 使用示例async function init() {  try {    const db = await openDatabase('MyApp', 1);    console.log('数据库准备就绪:', db.name);  } catch (error) {    console.error('初始化失败:', error);  }}

CRUD 操作 IndexedDBHelper {  constructor(dbName, version) {    this.dbName = dbName;    this.version = version;    this.db = null;  }    async init() {    this.db = await openDatabase(this.dbName, this.version);    return this;  }    // 添加数据  async add(storeName, data) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readwrite');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.add(data);            request.onsuccess = () => {        console.log('数据添加成功,ID:', request.result);        resolve(request.result);      };            request.onerror = () => {        console.error('数据添加失败:', request.error);        reject(request.error);      };            transaction.oncomplete = () => {        console.log('事务完成');      };            transaction.onerror = () => {        console.error('事务错误:', transaction.error);      };    });  }    // 批量添加  async addBatch(storeName, dataArray) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readwrite');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const results = [];            dataArray.forEach((data, index) => {        const request = objectStore.add(data);        request.onsuccess = () => {          results.push(request.result);        };      });            transaction.oncomplete = () => {        console.log(`批量添加成功,共 ${results.length} 条`);        resolve(results);      };            transaction.onerror = () => {        reject(transaction.error);      };    });  }    // 读取单条数据  async get(storeName, key) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.get(key);            request.onsuccess = () => {        resolve(request.result);      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }    // 读取所有数据  async getAll(storeName) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.getAll();            request.onsuccess = () => {        resolve(request.result);      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }    // 更新数据  async update(storeName, data) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readwrite');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.put(data);            request.onsuccess = () => {        console.log('数据更新成功');        resolve(request.result);      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }    // 删除数据  async delete(storeName, key) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readwrite');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.delete(key);            request.onsuccess = () => {        console.log('数据删除成功');        resolve();      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }    // 清空对象存储空间  async clear(storeName) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readwrite');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.clear();            request.onsuccess = () => {        console.log('数据已清空');        resolve();      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }    // 统计数据量  async count(storeName) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.count();            request.onsuccess = () => {        resolve(request.result);      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }}// 使用示例async function example() {  const db = new IndexedDBHelper('MyApp', 1);  await db.init();    // 添加数据  const userId = await db.add('users', {    name: 'Alice',    email: 'alice@example.com',    age: 25  });    // 读取数据  const user = await db.get('users', userId);  console.log('读取的用户:', user);    // 更新数据  await db.update('users', {    id: userId,    name: 'Alice Smith',    email: 'alice@example.com',    age: 26  });    // 批量添加  await db.addBatch('users', [    { name: 'Bob', email: 'bob@example.com', age: 30 },    { name: 'Charlie', email: 'charlie@example.com', age: 28 }  ]);    // 读取所有数据  const allUsers = await db.getAll('users');  console.log('所有用户:', allUsers);    // 统计数量  const count = await db.count('users');  console.log('用户总数:', count);    // 删除数据  await db.delete('users', userId);    // 清空表  // await db.clear('users');}

3. 高级查询与索引使用索引查询123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748495051525354555657585960616263646566676869707172737475767778798081828384858687888990919293949596979899100101102103104105106107108109110111112113114115116117118119120class IndexedDBQuery extends IndexedDBHelper {  // 通过索引查询单条数据  async getByIndex(storeName, indexName, value) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const index = objectStore.index(indexName);      const request = index.get(value);            request.onsuccess = () => {        resolve(request.result);      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }    // 通过索引查询所有匹配数据  async getAllByIndex(storeName, indexName, value) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const index = objectStore.index(indexName);      const request = index.getAll(value);            request.onsuccess = () => {        resolve(request.result);      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }    // 范围查询  async getByRange(storeName, indexName, lowerBound, upperBound, lowerOpen = false, upperOpen = false) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const index = objectStore.index(indexName);            // 创建范围      const range = IDBKeyRange.bound(lowerBound, upperBound, lowerOpen, upperOpen);      const request = index.getAll(range);            request.onsuccess = () => {        resolve(request.result);      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }    // 大于查询  async getGreaterThan(storeName, indexName, value, open = false) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const index = objectStore.index(indexName);            const range = IDBKeyRange.lowerBound(value, open);      const request = index.getAll(range);            request.onsuccess = () => {        resolve(request.result);      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }    // 小于查询  async getLessThan(storeName, indexName, value, open = false) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const index = objectStore.index(indexName);            const range = IDBKeyRange.upperBound(value, open);      const request = index.getAll(range);            request.onsuccess = () => {        resolve(request.result);      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }}// 使用示例async function queryExamples() {  const db = new IndexedDBQuery('MyApp', 1);  await db.init();    // 通过邮箱查询用户  const user = await db.getByIndex('users', 'email', 'alice@example.com');  console.log('用户:', user);    // 查询年龄在 25-30 之间的用户  const usersInRange = await db.getByRange('users', 'age', 25, 30);  console.log('25-30岁用户:', usersInRange);    // 查询年龄大于 25 的用户  const olderUsers = await db.getGreaterThan('users', 'age', 25);  console.log('25岁以上用户:', olderUsers);    // 查询年龄小于 30 的用户  const youngerUsers = await db.getLessThan('users', 'age', 30);  console.log('30岁以下用户:', youngerUsers);}

游标操作 IndexedDBCursor extends IndexedDBQuery {  // 使用游标遍历  async iterateWithCursor(storeName, callback) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.openCursor();            request.onsuccess = (event) => {        const cursor = event.target.result;                if (cursor) {          // 处理当前记录          callback(cursor.value, cursor.key);                    // 移动到下一条记录          cursor.continue();        } else {          // 遍历完成          resolve();        }      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }    // 使用游标更新  async updateWithCursor(storeName, condition, updateFn) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readwrite');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.openCursor();      let updatedCount = 0;            request.onsuccess = (event) => {        const cursor = event.target.result;                if (cursor) {          if (condition(cursor.value)) {            const updatedValue = updateFn(cursor.value);            cursor.update(updatedValue);            updatedCount++;          }          cursor.continue();        } else {          console.log(`更新了 ${updatedCount} 条记录`);          resolve(updatedCount);        }      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }    // 使用游标删除  async deleteWithCursor(storeName, condition) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readwrite');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.openCursor();      let deletedCount = 0;            request.onsuccess = (event) => {        const cursor = event.target.result;                if (cursor) {          if (condition(cursor.value)) {            cursor.delete();            deletedCount++;          }          cursor.continue();        } else {          console.log(`删除了 ${deletedCount} 条记录`);          resolve(deletedCount);        }      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }    // 分页查询  async paginate(storeName, page = 1, pageSize = 10) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.openCursor();            const skip = (page - 1) * pageSize;      let skipped = 0;      let collected = 0;      const results = [];            request.onsuccess = (event) => {        const cursor = event.target.result;                if (cursor) {          if (skipped < skip) {            // 跳过前面的记录            skipped++;            cursor.continue();          } else if (collected < pageSize) {            // 收集当前页的记录            results.push(cursor.value);            collected++;            cursor.continue();          } else {            // 已收集足够数据            resolve(results);          }        } else {          // 遍历结束          resolve(results);        }      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }    // 反向遍历  async iterateReverse(storeName, callback) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = this.db.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.openCursor(null, 'prev'); // 'prev' 表示反向            request.onsuccess = (event) => {        const cursor = event.target.result;                if (cursor) {          callback(cursor.value, cursor.key);          cursor.continue();        } else {          resolve();        }      };            request.onerror = () => {        reject(request.error);      };    });  }}// 使用示例async function cursorExamples() {  const db = new IndexedDBCursor('MyApp', 1);  await db.init();    // 遍历所有用户  await db.iterateWithCursor('users', (user, key) => {    console.log(`ID: ${key}, Name: ${user.name}, Age: ${user.age}`);  });    // 将所有用户的年龄加 1  await db.updateWithCursor('users',     user => user.age < 50,    user => ({ ...user, age: user.age + 1 })  );    // 删除年龄大于 60 的用户  await db.deleteWithCursor('users', user => user.age > 60);    // 分页查询:第 2 页,每页 5 条  const page2 = await db.paginate('users', 2, 5);  console.log('第 2 页数据:', page2);    // 反向遍历(从最新到最旧)  await db.iterateReverse('posts', (post) => {    console.log('文章:', post.title, post.timestamp);  });}

4. 在 React 中使用 IndexedDBuseIndexedDB  src/hooks/useIndexedDB.jsimport { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';export function useIndexedDB(dbName, version, stores) {  const [db, setDb] = useState(null);  const [isReady, setIsReady] = useState(false);  const [error, setError] = useState(null);  const dbRef = useRef(null);    // 初始化数据库  useEffect(() => {    const openDB = async () => {      try {        const request = indexedDB.open(dbName, version);                request.onerror = () => {          setError(request.error);        };                request.onsuccess = () => {          dbRef.current = request.result;          setDb(request.result);          setIsReady(true);        };                request.onupgradeneeded = (event) => {          const database = event.target.result;                    stores.forEach(({ name, keyPath, autoIncrement, indexes }) => {            if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains(name)) {              const objectStore = database.createObjectStore(name, {                keyPath,                autoIncrement              });                            // 创建索引              if (indexes) {                indexes.forEach(({ name: indexName, keyPath: indexKeyPath, unique }) => {                  objectStore.createIndex(indexName, indexKeyPath, { unique });                });              }            }          });        };      } catch (err) {        setError(err);      }    };        openDB();        return () => {      if (dbRef.current) {        dbRef.current.close();      }    };  }, [dbName, version, stores]);    // 添加数据  const add = useCallback(async (storeName, data) => {    if (!dbRef.current) throw new Error('Database not initialized');        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = dbRef.current.transaction([storeName], 'readwrite');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.add(data);            request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);    });  }, []);    // 获取数据  const get = useCallback(async (storeName, key) => {    if (!dbRef.current) throw new Error('Database not initialized');        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = dbRef.current.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.get(key);            request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);    });  }, []);    // 获取所有数据  const getAll = useCallback(async (storeName) => {    if (!dbRef.current) throw new Error('Database not initialized');        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = dbRef.current.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.getAll();            request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);    });  }, []);    // 更新数据  const update = useCallback(async (storeName, data) => {    if (!dbRef.current) throw new Error('Database not initialized');        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = dbRef.current.transaction([storeName], 'readwrite');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.put(data);            request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);    });  }, []);    // 删除数据  const remove = useCallback(async (storeName, key) => {    if (!dbRef.current) throw new Error('Database not initialized');        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = dbRef.current.transaction([storeName], 'readwrite');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.delete(key);            request.onsuccess = () => resolve();      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);    });  }, []);    // 清空存储空间  const clear = useCallback(async (storeName) => {    if (!dbRef.current) throw new Error('Database not initialized');        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = dbRef.current.transaction([storeName], 'readwrite');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);      const request = objectStore.clear();            request.onsuccess = () => resolve();      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);    });  }, []);    return {    db,    isReady,    error,    add,    get,    getAll,    update,    remove,    clear  };}// 使用示例function TodoApp() {  const [todos, setTodos] = useState([]);  const [newTodo, setNewTodo] = useState('');    const { isReady, add, getAll, update, remove } = useIndexedDB(    'TodoDB',    1,    [      {        name: 'todos',        keyPath: 'id',        autoIncrement: true,        indexes: [          { name: 'completed', keyPath: 'completed', unique: false },          { name: 'createdAt', keyPath: 'createdAt', unique: false }        ]      }    ]  );    // 加载数据  useEffect(() => {    if (isReady) {      loadTodos();    }  }, [isReady]);    const loadTodos = async () => {    try {      const allTodos = await getAll('todos');      setTodos(allTodos);    } catch (error) {      console.error('加载失败:', error);    }  };    const handleAdd = async () => {    if (!newTodo.trim()) return;        try {      await add('todos', {        text: newTodo,        completed: false,        createdAt: Date.now()      });      alert('上传失败!');    } finally {      setUploading(false);    }  };    const handleDownload = async (fileId) => {    const { blob, metadata } = await storageRef.current.getFile(fileId);    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);        const a = document.createElement('a');    a.href = url;    a.download = metadata.name;    a.click();        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);  };    const handleDelete = async (fileId) => {    if (confirm('确定要删除这个文件吗?')) {      await storageRef.current.deleteFile(fileId);      loadFiles();    }  };    return (    <div className="file-uploader">      <h2>文件管理器</h2>            <div className="upload-area">        <input          type="file"          onChange={handleUpload}          disabled={uploading}        />        {uploading && <span>上传中...</span>}      </div>            <div className="file-list">        <h3>已保存的文件</h3>        <table>          <thead>            <tr>              <th>文件名</th>              <th>大小</th>              <th>上传日期</th>              <th>操作</th>            </tr>          </thead>          <tbody>            {files.map(file => (              <tr key={file.id}>                <td>{file.name}</td>                <td>{(file.size / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2)} MB</td>                <td>{new Date(file.uploadDate).toLocaleString()}</td>                <td>                  <button onClick={() => handleDownload(file.id)}>下载</button>                  <button onClick={() => handleDelete(file.id)}>删除</button>                </td>              </tr>            ))}          </tbody>        </table>      </div>    </div>  );}

6. 性能优化批量操作优化1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132333435363738394041424344454647484950515253545556575859606162636465666768// 批量插入优化async function batchInsert(db, storeName, dataArray) {  const batchSize = 1000;  const batches = [];    for (let i = 0; i < dataArray.length; i += batchSize) {    batches.push(dataArray.slice(i, i + batchSize));  }    for (const batch of batches) {    await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const transaction = db.transaction([storeName], 'readwrite');      const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);            batch.forEach(data => objectStore.add(data));            transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();      transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);    });  }}// 使用索引优化查询async function optimizedQuery(db, storeName, indexName, value) {  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {    const transaction = db.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');    const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);    const index = objectStore.index(indexName);    const request = index.get(value);        request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);  });}// 游标缓冲优化async function bufferCursor(db, storeName, batchSize = 100) {  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {    const results = [];    const transaction = db.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');    const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);    const request = objectStore.openCursor();        let buffer = [];        request.onsuccess = (event) => {      const cursor = event.target.result;            if (cursor) {        buffer.push(cursor.value);                if (buffer.length >= batchSize) {          results.push(...buffer);          buffer = [];        }                cursor.continue();      } else {        if (buffer.length > 0) {          results.push(...buffer);        }        resolve(results);      }    };        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);  });}

内存管理12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637383940414243444546474849505152// 流式读取大数据async function streamLargeData(db, storeName, processor) {  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {    const transaction = db.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');    const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);    const request = objectStore.openCursor();        request.onsuccess = async (event) => {      const cursor = event.target.result;            if (cursor) {        await processor(cursor.value);        cursor.continue();      } else {        resolve();      }    };        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);  });}// 使用 Web Worker 处理大量数据// worker.jsself.onmessage = async (e) => {  const { dbName, storeName, operation } = e.data;    const db = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {    const request = indexedDB.open(dbName);    request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);  });    if (operation === 'process') {    // 在 Worker 中处理数据    const results = [];    const transaction = db.transaction([storeName], 'readonly');    const objectStore = transaction.objectStore(storeName);    const request = objectStore.openCursor();        request.onsuccess = (event) => {      const cursor = event.target.result;      if (cursor) {        // 处理数据        results.push(processData(cursor.value));        cursor.continue();      } else {        self.postMessage({ results });      }    };  }};

7. 最佳实践与注意事项数据库设计原则123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748495051525354555657585960616263646566// 1. 合理设计对象存储空间const goodDesign = {  // ✅ 使用有意义的 keyPath  keyPath: 'id',    // ✅ 适当使用自增主键  autoIncrement: true,    // ✅ 为常用查询字段创建索引  indexes: [    { name: 'email', keyPath: 'email', unique: true },    { name: 'createdAt', keyPath: 'createdAt', unique: false }  ]};// 2. 避免存储冗余数据// ❌ 不好的设计const badPost = {  id: 1,  title: 'Post',  author: {    id: 1,    name: 'Alice',    email: 'alice@example.com',    bio: '...'  }};// ✅ 好的设计const goodPost = {  id: 1,  title: 'Post',  authorId: 1};// 3. 使用事务保证数据一致性async function transferData(db, fromId, toId, amount) {  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {    const transaction = db.transaction(['accounts'], 'readwrite');    const objectStore = transaction.objectStore('accounts');        // 读取账户    const getFrom = objectStore.get(fromId);    const getTo = objectStore.get(toId);        getFrom.onsuccess = () => {      getTo.onsuccess = () => {        const fromAccount = getFrom.result;        const toAccount = getTo.result;                if (fromAccount.balance >= amount) {          fromAccount.balance -= amount;          toAccount.balance += amount;                    objectStore.put(fromAccount);          objectStore.put(toAccount);        } else {          transaction.abort();        }      };    };        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();    transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);  });}

错误处理1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829// 完善的错误处理class SafeIndexedDB {  async operation(fn) {    try {      return await fn();    } catch (error) {      if (error.name === 'QuotaExceededError') {        console.error('存储空间不足');        // 清理旧数据        await this.cleanup();      } else if (error.name === 'VersionError') {        console.error('数据库版本冲突');        // 重新初始化        await this.reinitialize();      } else {        console.error('操作失败:', error);      }      throw error;    }  }    async cleanup() {    // 清理逻辑  }    async reinitialize() {    // 重新初始化逻辑  }}

8. 总结IndexedDB 是浏览器中功能最强大的客户端存储方案,适合:
最佳应用场景
PWA 离线应用:缓存 API 响应和资源文件
大量结构化数据:本地数据管理、离线编辑
文件存储:图片、音频、视频等媒体文件
离线同步:本地修改,联网后同步到服务器
性能优化:减少网络请求,提升加载速度

关键优势
大容量:远超 LocalStorage 的存储限制
异步操作:不阻塞主线程
索引支持:高效的数据查询
事务机制:保证数据一致性
丰富的数据类型:支持对象、Blob 等

注意事项
浏览器兼容性(IE 10+,现代浏览器)
用户可以清除数据
受同源策略限制
需要合理的错误处理
注意存储配额管理

通过合理使用 IndexedDB,可以构建功能强大的离线优先(Offline-First)Web 应用,为用户提供流畅可靠的体验,即使在网络不稳定的情况下也能正常使用。

title: WebSocket 与 WebRTC 深入对比与实践
content:
WebSocket 与 WebRTC 深入对比与实践1. 概述与核心区别WebSocket 简介WebSocket 是一种在单个 TCP 连接上进行全双工通信的协议,允许服务器主动向客户端推送数据。
核心特点:

协议升级:从 HTTP 升级到 WebSocket 协议
全双工通信:客户端和服务器可以同时发送和接收数据
持久连接:建立连接后保持打开状态
低延迟:无需 HTTP 轮询的开销
服务器架构:需要服务器支持和维护连接

WebRTC 简介WebRTC (Web Real-Time Communication) 是一个支持浏览器之间进行实时音视频通信和数据传输的开放标准。
核心特点:

点对点通信:浏览器之间直接连接,无需经过服务器
多媒体支持:原生支持音频、视频流传输
低延迟:P2P 连接延迟更低
NAT 穿透:通过 STUN/TURN 服务器穿透防火墙
加密传输:内置 DTLS 和 SRTP 加密

核心区别对比1234567891011121314// WebSocket: 客户端-服务器架构const ws = new WebSocket('ws://server.com');ws.onmessage = (event) => {  console.log('从服务器接收:', event.data);};ws.send('发送到服务器');// WebRTC: 点对点架构const peerConnection = new RTCPeerConnection(config);const dataChannel = peerConnection.createDataChannel('channel');dataChannel.onmessage = (event) => {  console.log('从对等端接收:', event.data);};dataChannel.send('直接发送给对方');




特性
WebSocket
WebRTC



通信模式
客户端-服务器
点对点(P2P)


主要用途
文本/二进制数据传输
音视频流 + 数据通道


延迟
较低(经过服务器)
极低(直连)


服务器负载
需维护所有连接
仅信令交换


带宽消耗
服务器带宽
对等端带宽


扩展性
受服务器限制
高度可扩展


穿透能力
不需要
需要 STUN/TURN


浏览器支持
广泛支持
现代浏览器支持


2. WebSocket 深入实践基础连接管理 WebSocketClient {  constructor(url, options = {}) {    this.url = url;    this.options = {      reconnectInterval: 1000,      maxReconnectInterval: 30000,      reconnectDecay: 1.5,      maxReconnectAttempts: null,      ...options    };        this.ws = null;    this.reconnectAttempts = 0;    this.listeners = new Map();        this.connect();  }    connect() {    try {      this.ws = new WebSocket(this.url);            this.ws.onopen = (event) => {        console.log('WebSocket 连接成功');        this.reconnectAttempts = 0;        this.emit('open', event);      };            this.ws.onmessage = (event) => {        try {          const data = JSON.parse(event.data);          this.emit('message', data);                    // 根据消息类型分发          if (data.type) {            this.emit(data.type, data.payload);          }        } catch (error) {          this.emit('message', event.data);        }      };            this.ws.onerror = (error) => {        console.error('WebSocket 错误:', error);        this.emit('error', error);      };            this.ws.onclose = (event) => {        console.log('WebSocket 连接关闭:', event.code, event.reason);        this.emit('close', event);                // 自动重连        if (!event.wasClean) {          this.reconnect();        }      };    } catch (error) {      console.error('WebSocket 连接失败:', error);      this.reconnect();    }  }    reconnect() {    if (this.options.maxReconnectAttempts &&         this.reconnectAttempts >= this.options.maxReconnectAttempts) {      console.log('达到最大重连次数');      return;    }        this.reconnectAttempts++;        const timeout = Math.min(      this.options.reconnectInterval * Math.pow(this.options.reconnectDecay, this.reconnectAttempts),      this.options.maxReconnectInterval    );        console.log(`${timeout}ms 后尝试重连 (第 ${this.reconnectAttempts} 次)`);        setTimeout(() => {      this.connect();    }, timeout);  }    send(type, payload) {    if (this.ws && this.ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {      const message = JSON.stringify({ type, payload, timestamp: Date.now() });      this.ws.send(message);    } else {      console.warn('WebSocket 未连接,消息未发送');    }  }    on(event, callback) {    if (!this.listeners.has(event)) {      this.listeners.set(event, []);    }    this.listeners.get(event).push(callback);  }    off(event, callback) {    if (this.listeners.has(event)) {      const callbacks = this.listeners.get(event);      const index = callbacks.indexOf(callback);      if (index > -1) {        callbacks.splice(index, 1);      }    }  }    emit(event, data) {    if (this.listeners.has(event)) {      this.listeners.get(event).forEach(callback => callback(data));    }  }    close() {    if (this.ws) {      this.ws.close();      this.ws = null;    }  }}// 使用示例const client = new WebSocketClient('ws://localhost:8080', {  reconnectInterval: 1000,  maxReconnectAttempts: 10});client.on('open', () => {  console.log('连接已建立');  client.send('join', { room: 'chat-room' });});client.on('message', (data) => {  console.log('收到消息:', data);});client.on('chat', (message) => {  console.log('聊天消息:', message);});

心跳机制123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445class WebSocketWithHeartbeat extends WebSocketClient {  constructor(url, options = {}) {    super(url, options);    this.heartbeatInterval = options.heartbeatInterval || 30000;    this.heartbeatTimer = null;    this.pongTimeout = options.pongTimeout || 5000;    this.pongTimer = null;        this.on('open', () => this.startHeartbeat());    this.on('close', () => this.stopHeartbeat());    this.on('pong', () => this.handlePong());  }    startHeartbeat() {    this.stopHeartbeat();        this.heartbeatTimer = setInterval(() => {      this.send('ping', { timestamp: Date.now() });            // 等待 pong 响应      this.pongTimer = setTimeout(() => {        console.log('心跳超时,重新连接');        this.ws.close();      }, this.pongTimeout);    }, this.heartbeatInterval);  }    stopHeartbeat() {    if (this.heartbeatTimer) {      clearInterval(this.heartbeatTimer);      this.heartbeatTimer = null;    }    if (this.pongTimer) {      clearTimeout(this.pongTimer);      this.pongTimer = null;    }  }    handlePong() {    if (this.pongTimer) {      clearTimeout(this.pongTimer);      this.pongTimer = null;    }  }}

消息队列与重发机制1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132333435363738394041424344454647484950515253545556575859606162636465666768697071727374class ReliableWebSocket extends WebSocketWithHeartbeat {  constructor(url, options = {}) {    super(url, options);    this.messageQueue = [];    this.pendingMessages = new Map();    this.messageIdCounter = 0;        this.on('open', () => this.flushQueue());    this.on('ack', (data) => this.handleAck(data));  }    sendReliable(type, payload) {    const messageId = ++this.messageIdCounter;    const message = { id: messageId, type, payload, timestamp: Date.now() };        if (this.ws && this.ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {      this.doSend(message);      this.pendingMessages.set(messageId, {        message,        retryCount: 0,        timer: this.setRetryTimer(message)      });    } else {      this.messageQueue.push(message);    }        return messageId;  }    doSend(message) {    this.ws.send(JSON.stringify(message));  }    setRetryTimer(message, delay = 3000) {    return setTimeout(() => {      if (this.pendingMessages.has(message.id)) {        const pending = this.pendingMessages.get(message.id);                if (pending.retryCount < 3) {          console.log(`重发消息 ${message.id} (第 ${pending.retryCount + 1} 次)`);          this.doSend(message);          pending.retryCount++;          pending.timer = this.setRetryTimer(message, delay * 2);        } else {          console.error(`消息 ${message.id} 发送失败`);          this.pendingMessages.delete(message.id);          this.emit('send-failed', message);        }      }    }, delay);  }    handleAck(data) {    const { messageId } = data;    if (this.pendingMessages.has(messageId)) {      const pending = this.pendingMessages.get(messageId);      clearTimeout(pending.timer);      this.pendingMessages.delete(messageId);      this.emit('send-success', messageId);    }  }    flushQueue() {    while (this.messageQueue.length > 0) {      const message = this.messageQueue.shift();      this.doSend(message);      this.pendingMessages.set(message.id, {        message,        retryCount: 0,        timer: this.setRetryTimer(message)      });    }  }}

3. WebRTC 深入实践建立 P2P 连接的完整流程 WebRTCPeer {  constructor(config = {}) {    this.config = {      iceServers: [        { urls: 'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302' },        {          urls: 'turn:turn.example.com:3478',          username: 'user',          credential: 'pass'        }      ],      ...config    };        this.pc = null;    this.dataChannel = null;    this.localStream = null;    this.remoteStream = null;    this.listeners = new Map();  }    async createPeerConnection() {    this.pc = new RTCPeerConnection(this.config);        // ICE 候选事件    this.pc.onicecandidate = (event) => {      if (event.candidate) {        console.log('生成 ICE 候选:', event.candidate);        this.emit('ice-candidate', event.candidate);      }    };        // ICE 连接状态变化    this.pc.oniceconnectionstatechange = () => {      console.log('ICE 连接状态:', this.pc.iceConnectionState);      this.emit('ice-state-change', this.pc.iceConnectionState);            if (this.pc.iceConnectionState === 'disconnected' ||           this.pc.iceConnectionState === 'failed') {        this.handleConnectionFailure();      }    };        // 接收远程流    this.pc.ontrack = (event) => {      console.log('接收到远程流');      this.remoteStream = event.streams[0];      this.emit('remote-stream', this.remoteStream);    };        // 数据通道接收    this.pc.ondatachannel = (event) => {      console.log('接收到数据通道');      this.setupDataChannel(event.channel);    };  }    setupDataChannel(channel) {    this.dataChannel = channel;        this.dataChannel.onopen = () => {      console.log('数据通道已打开');      this.emit('data-channel-open');    };        this.dataChannel.onclose = () => {      console.log('数据通道已关闭');      this.emit('data-channel-close');    };        this.dataChannel.onmessage = (event) => {      console.log('接收数据:', event.data);      this.emit('data', event.data);    };        this.dataChannel.onerror = (error) => {      console.error('数据通道错误:', error);      this.emit('data-channel-error', error);    };  }    async createOffer() {    await this.createPeerConnection();        // 创建数据通道    this.dataChannel = this.pc.createDataChannel('data', {      ordered: true,      maxRetransmits: 3    });    this.setupDataChannel(this.dataChannel);        // 如果有本地流,添加到连接    if (this.localStream) {      this.localStream.getTracks().forEach(track => {        this.pc.addTrack(track, this.localStream);      });    }        // 创建 Offer    const offer = await this.pc.createOffer({      offerToReceiveAudio: true,      offerToReceiveVideo: true    });        await this.pc.setLocalDescription(offer);        return offer;  }    async createAnswer(offer) {    await this.createPeerConnection();        // 如果有本地流,添加到连接    if (this.localStream) {      this.localStream.getTracks().forEach(track => {        this.pc.addTrack(track, this.localStream);      });    }        await this.pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(offer));        const answer = await this.pc.createAnswer();    await this.pc.setLocalDescription(answer);        return answer;  }    async setRemoteAnswer(answer) {    await this.pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(answer));  }    async addIceCandidate(candidate) {    try {      await this.pc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(candidate));    } catch (error) {      console.error('添加 ICE 候选失败:', error);    }  }    async getUserMedia(constraints = { audio: true, video: true }) {    try {      this.localStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(constraints);      this.emit('local-stream', this.localStream);      return this.localStream;    } catch (error) {      console.error('获取媒体流失败:', error);      throw error;    }  }    async getDisplayMedia(constraints = { video: true }) {    try {      this.localStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia(constraints);      this.emit('local-stream', this.localStream);      return this.localStream;    } catch (error) {      console.error('获取屏幕共享失败:', error);      throw error;    }  }    sendData(data) {    if (this.dataChannel && this.dataChannel.readyState === 'open') {      this.dataChannel.send(data);    } else {      console.warn('数据通道未打开');    }  }    handleConnectionFailure() {    console.log('连接失败,尝试重新协商');    this.emit('connection-failed');        // 可以实现 ICE 重启    if (this.pc) {      this.pc.restartIce();    }  }    close() {    if (this.dataChannel) {      this.dataChannel.close();      this.dataChannel = null;    }        if (this.localStream) {      this.localStream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());      this.localStream = null;    }        if (this.pc) {      this.pc.close();      this.pc = null;    }  }    on(event, callback) {    if (!this.listeners.has(event)) {      this.listeners.set(event, []);    }    this.listeners.get(event).push(callback);  }    emit(event, data) {    if (this.listeners.has(event)) {      this.listeners.get(event).forEach(callback => callback(data));    }  }}

信令服务器实现123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748495051525354555657585960616263646566676869707172737475767778798081828384858687888990// 使用 WebSocket 作为信令通道class SignalingClient {  constructor(url) {    this.ws = new WebSocket(url);    this.listeners = new Map();        this.ws.onmessage = (event) => {      const message = JSON.parse(event.data);      this.emit(message.type, message.data);    };  }    send(type, data) {    this.ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type, data }));  }    on(event, callback) {    if (!this.listeners.has(event)) {      this.listeners.set(event, []);    }    this.listeners.get(event).push(callback);  }    emit(event, data) {    if (this.listeners.has(event)) {      this.listeners.get(event).forEach(callback => callback(data));    }  }}// 完整的 WebRTC 连接建立流程class WebRTCConnection {  constructor(signalingUrl, isInitiator) {    this.signaling = new SignalingClient(signalingUrl);    this.peer = new WebRTCPeer();    this.isInitiator = isInitiator;        this.setupSignaling();    this.setupPeer();  }    setupSignaling() {    // 接收 offer    this.signaling.on('offer', async (offer) => {      console.log('接收到 offer');      const answer = await this.peer.createAnswer(offer);      this.signaling.send('answer', answer);    });        // 接收 answer    this.signaling.on('answer', async (answer) => {      console.log('接收到 answer');      await this.peer.setRemoteAnswer(answer);    });        // 接收 ICE 候选    this.signaling.on('ice-candidate', async (candidate) => {      console.log('接收到 ICE 候选');      await this.peer.addIceCandidate(candidate);    });  }    setupPeer() {    // 发送 ICE 候选    this.peer.on('ice-candidate', (candidate) => {      this.signaling.send('ice-candidate', candidate);    });  }    async start() {    if (this.isInitiator) {      // 发起方创建 offer      const offer = await this.peer.createOffer();      this.signaling.send('offer', offer);    }  }}// 使用示例const connection = new WebRTCConnection('ws://signaling.server.com', true);connection.start();connection.peer.on('data-channel-open', () => {  console.log('可以开始发送数据了');  connection.peer.sendData('Hello!');});connection.peer.on('data', (data) => {  console.log('接收到数据:', data);});

4. 在 React 中使用 WebSocketuseWebSocket  src/hooks/useWebSocket.jsimport { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';export function useWebSocket(url, options = {}) {  const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState(false);  const [lastMessage, setLastMessage] = useState(null);  const [connectionStatus, setConnectionStatus] = useState('disconnected');    const wsRef = useRef(null);  const reconnectTimerRef = useRef(null);  const reconnectAttemptsRef = useRef(0);  const listenersRef = useRef(new Map());    const {    reconnect = true,    reconnectInterval = 3000,    reconnectAttempts = 10,    onOpen,    onClose,    onError,    onMessage  } = options;    // 发送消息  const sendMessage = useCallback((data) => {    if (wsRef.current && wsRef.current.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {      const message = typeof data === 'string' ? data : JSON.stringify(data);      wsRef.current.send(message);      return true;    }    console.warn('WebSocket 未连接');    return false;  }, []);    // 订阅特定类型的消息  const subscribe = useCallback((type, callback) => {    if (!listenersRef.current.has(type)) {      listenersRef.current.set(type, []);    }    listenersRef.current.get(type).push(callback);        return () => {      const listeners = listenersRef.current.get(type);      const index = listeners.indexOf(callback);      if (index > -1) {        listeners.splice(index, 1);      }    };  }, []);    // 连接函数  const connect = useCallback(() => {    try {      setConnectionStatus('connecting');      wsRef.current = new WebSocket(url);            wsRef.current.onopen = (event) => {        console.log('WebSocket 连接成功');        setIsConnected(true);        setConnectionStatus('connected');        reconnectAttemptsRef.current = 0;        onOpen?.(event);      };            wsRef.current.onmessage = (event) => {        try {          const data = JSON.parse(event.data);          setLastMessage(data);                    // 触发全局 onMessage          onMessage?.(data);                    // 触发特定类型的监听器          if (data.type && listenersRef.current.has(data.type)) {            listenersRef.current.get(data.type).forEach(cb => cb(data.payload));          }        } catch (error) {          setLastMessage(event.data);          onMessage?.(event.data);        }      };            wsRef.current.onerror = (error) => {        console.error('WebSocket 错误:', error);        onError?.(error);      };            wsRef.current.onclose = (event) => {        console.log('WebSocket 连接关闭');        setIsConnected(false);        setConnectionStatus('disconnected');        onClose?.(event);                // 自动重连        if (reconnect && !event.wasClean &&             reconnectAttemptsRef.current < reconnectAttempts) {          reconnectAttemptsRef.current++;          setConnectionStatus('reconnecting');                    reconnectTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {            console.log(`尝试重连 (${reconnectAttemptsRef.current}/${reconnectAttempts})`);            connect();          }, reconnectInterval);        }      };    } catch (error) {      console.error('WebSocket 连接失败:', error);      setConnectionStatus('error');    }  }, [url, reconnect, reconnectInterval, reconnectAttempts, onOpen, onClose, onError, onMessage]);    // 断开连接  const disconnect = useCallback(() => {    if (reconnectTimerRef.current) {      clearTimeout(reconnectTimerRef.current);    }    if (wsRef.current) {      wsRef.current.close();      wsRef.current = null;    }  }, []);    // 组件挂载时连接  useEffect(() => {    connect();        return () => {      disconnect();    };  }, [connect, disconnect]);    return {    isConnected,    connectionStatus,    lastMessage,    sendMessage,    subscribe,    connect,    disconnect  };}// 使用示例function ChatComponent() {  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState('');    const { isConnected, sendMessage, subscribe } = useWebSocket(    'ws://localhost:8080',    {      onOpen: () => console.log('连接已建立'),      onClose: () => console.log('连接已关闭')    }  );    // 订阅聊天消息  useEffect(() => {    const unsubscribe = subscribe('chat', (message) => {      setMessages(prev => [...prev, message]);    });        return unsubscribe;  }, [subscribe]);    const handleSend = () => {    if (inputValue.trim()) {      sendMessage({        type: 'chat',        payload: {          text: inputValue,          timestamp: Date.now()        }      });      setInputValue('');    }  };    return (    <div className="chat-container">      <div className="status">        {isConnected ? '🟢 已连接' : '🔴 未连接'}      </div>            <div className="messages">        {messages.map((msg, index) => (          <div key={index} className="message">            {msg.text}          </div>        ))}      </div>            <div className="input-area">        <input          value={inputValue}          onChange={(e) => setInputValue(e.target.value)}          onKeyPress={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && handleSend()}          placeholder="输入消息..."        />        <button onClick={handleSend} disabled={!isConnected}>          发送        </button>      </div>    </div>  );}

WebSocket Context  src/contexts/WebSocketContext.jsximport React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';const WebSocketContext = createContext(null);export function WebSocketProvider({ url, children }) {  const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState(false);  const wsRef = useRef(null);  const listenersRef = useRef(new Map());    useEffect(() => {    // 创建连接    wsRef.current = new WebSocket(url);        wsRef.current.onopen = () => {      console.log('WebSocket 全局连接成功');      setIsConnected(true);    };        wsRef.current.onmessage = (event) => {      try {        const data = JSON.parse(event.data);                // 分发消息给所有订阅者        if (data.type && listenersRef.current.has(data.type)) {          listenersRef.current.get(data.type).forEach(callback => {            callback(data.payload);          });        }                // 分发给通用监听器        if (listenersRef.current.has('*')) {          listenersRef.current.get('*').forEach(callback => {            callback(data);          });        }      } catch (error) {        console.error('消息解析失败:', error);      }    };        wsRef.current.onclose = () => {      console.log('WebSocket 全局连接关闭');      setIsConnected(false);    };        wsRef.current.onerror = (error) => {      console.error('WebSocket 全局错误:', error);    };        return () => {      if (wsRef.current) {        wsRef.current.close();      }    };  }, [url]);    const subscribe = (type, callback) => {    if (!listenersRef.current.has(type)) {      listenersRef.current.set(type, new Set());    }    listenersRef.current.get(type).add(callback);        return () => {      listenersRef.current.get(type)?.delete(callback);    };  };    const sendMessage = (type, payload) => {    if (wsRef.current && wsRef.current.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {      wsRef.current.send(JSON.stringify({ type, payload }));      return true;    }    return false;  };    return (    <WebSocketContext.Provider value={{ isConnected, subscribe, sendMessage }}>      {children}    </WebSocketContext.Provider>  );}export function useWebSocketContext() {  const context = useContext(WebSocketContext);  if (!context) {    throw new Error('useWebSocketContext 必须在 WebSocketProvider 内使用');  }  return context;}// 使用示例function App() {  return (    <WebSocketProvider url="ws://localhost:8080">      <ChatRoom />      <Notifications />    </WebSocketProvider>  );}function ChatRoom() {  const { isConnected, subscribe, sendMessage } = useWebSocketContext();  const [messages, setMessages] = useState([]);    useEffect(() => {    return subscribe('chat', (message) => {      setMessages(prev => [...prev, message]);    });  }, [subscribe]);    return (    <div>      <h2>聊天室 {isConnected ? '🟢' : '🔴'}</h2>      <div className="messages">        {messages.map((msg, i) => (          <div key={i}>{msg.text}</div>        ))}      </div>      <button onClick={() => sendMessage('chat', { text: 'Hello' })}>        发送消息      </button>    </div>  );}function Notifications() {  const { subscribe } = useWebSocketContext();  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState([]);    useEffect(() => {    return subscribe('notification', (notification) => {      setNotifications(prev => [...prev, notification]);    });  }, [subscribe]);    return (    <div className="notifications">      {notifications.map((notif, i) => (        <div key={i} className="notification">{notif.message}</div>      ))}    </div>  );}

实时协作编辑器示例 src/components/CollaborativeEditor.jsximport React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';import { useWebSocket } from '../hooks/useWebSocket';export function CollaborativeEditor({ documentId, userId }) {  const [content, setContent] = useState('');  const [cursors, setCursors] = useState({});  const editorRef = useRef(null);  const isRemoteChangeRef = useRef(false);    const { isConnected, sendMessage, subscribe } = useWebSocket(    'ws://localhost:8080',    {      onOpen: () => {        // 加入文档编辑会话        sendMessage({          type: 'join',          payload: { documentId, userId }        });      }    }  );    // 订阅文档变更  useEffect(() => {    const unsubscribeChange = subscribe('document-change', (data) => {      if (data.userId !== userId) {        isRemoteChangeRef.current = true;        applyRemoteChange(data);      }    });        const unsubscribeCursor = subscribe('cursor-position', (data) => {      if (data.userId !== userId) {        setCursors(prev => ({          ...prev,          [data.userId]: data.position        }));      }    });        return () => {      unsubscribeChange();      unsubscribeCursor();    };  }, [subscribe, userId]);    // 应用远程更改  const applyRemoteChange = (change) => {    const { operation, position, text } = change;        setContent(prevContent => {      if (operation === 'insert') {        return prevContent.slice(0, position) + text + prevContent.slice(position);      } else if (operation === 'delete') {        return prevContent.slice(0, position) + prevContent.slice(position + text.length);      }      return prevContent;    });  };    // 处理本地输入  const handleChange = (e) => {    const newContent = e.target.value;    const cursorPosition = e.target.selectionStart;        if (!isRemoteChangeRef.current) {      // 计算变更      const operation = newContent.length > content.length ? 'insert' : 'delete';      const position = cursorPosition - (newContent.length - content.length);      const text = operation === 'insert'         ? newContent.slice(position, cursorPosition)        : content.slice(position, position + (content.length - newContent.length));            // 发送变更      sendMessage({        type: 'document-change',        payload: {          documentId,          userId,          operation,          position,          text,          timestamp: Date.now()        }      });    }        setContent(newContent);    isRemoteChangeRef.current = false;  };    // 处理光标移动  const handleSelectionChange = (e) => {    const position = e.target.selectionStart;    sendMessage({      type: 'cursor-position',      payload: {        documentId,        userId,        position      }    });  };    return (    <div className="collaborative-editor">      <div className="editor-header">        <span>文档协作编辑器</span>        <span className={isConnected ? 'status-online' : 'status-offline'}>          {isConnected ? '● 在线' : '○ 离线'}        </span>        <span>活跃用户: {Object.keys(cursors).length + 1}</span>      </div>            <div className="editor-container">        <textarea          ref={editorRef}          value={content}          onChange={handleChange}          onSelect={handleSelectionChange}          placeholder="开始输入..."          className="editor-textarea"        />                {/* 显示其他用户的光标 */}        {Object.entries(cursors).map(([uid, position]) => (          <div            key={uid}            className="remote-cursor"            style={{              left: `${position * 8}px` // 简化的位置计算            }}          >            <div className="cursor-flag">用户 {uid}</div>          </div>        ))}      </div>    </div>  );}

5. 在 React 中使用 WebRTCuseWebRTC  src/hooks/useWebRTC.jsimport { useEffect, useRef, useState, useCallback } from 'react';export function useWebRTC(signalingUrl, roomId) {  const [localStream, setLocalStream] = useState(null);  const [remoteStream, setRemoteStream] = useState(null);  const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState(false);  const [connectionState, setConnectionState] = useState('new');    const pcRef = useRef(null);  const wsRef = useRef(null);  const dataChannelRef = useRef(null);    // 初始化 PeerConnection  const initializePeerConnection = useCallback(() => {    const config = {      iceServers: [        { urls: 'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302' },        { urls: 'stun:stun1.l.google.com:19302' }      ]    };        pcRef.current = new RTCPeerConnection(config);        // 监听 ICE 候选    pcRef.current.onicecandidate = (event) => {      if (event.candidate && wsRef.current) {        wsRef.current.send(JSON.stringify({          type: 'ice-candidate',          candidate: event.candidate,          roomId        }));      }    };        // 监听连接状态    pcRef.current.oniceconnectionstatechange = () => {      setConnectionState(pcRef.current.iceConnectionState);      setIsConnected(pcRef.current.iceConnectionState === 'connected');    };        // 接收远程流    pcRef.current.ontrack = (event) => {      console.log('接收到远程流');      setRemoteStream(event.streams[0]);    };        // 数据通道    pcRef.current.ondatachannel = (event) => {      dataChannelRef.current = event.channel;      setupDataChannelListeners();    };  }, [roomId]);    // 设置数据通道监听器  const setupDataChannelListeners = () => {    if (dataChannelRef.current) {      dataChannelRef.current.onopen = () => {        console.log('数据通道已打开');      };            dataChannelRef.current.onmessage = (event) => {        console.log('接收数据:', event.data);        // 可以添加自定义的消息处理      };    }  };    // 连接信令服务器  useEffect(() => {    wsRef.current = new WebSocket(signalingUrl);        wsRef.current.onopen = () => {      console.log('信令服务器连接成功');      wsRef.current.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'join', roomId }));    };        wsRef.current.onmessage = async (event) => {      const message = JSON.parse(event.data);            switch (message.type) {        case 'offer':          await handleOffer(message.offer);          break;        case 'answer':          await handleAnswer(message.answer);          break;        case 'ice-candidate':          await handleIceCandidate(message.candidate);          break;        default:          break;      }    };        return () => {      if (wsRef.current) {        wsRef.current.close();      }    };  }, [signalingUrl, roomId]);    // 处理 Offer  const handleOffer = async (offer) => {    if (!pcRef.current) {      initializePeerConnection();    }        await pcRef.current.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(offer));    const answer = await pcRef.current.createAnswer();    await pcRef.current.setLocalDescription(answer);        wsRef.current.send(JSON.stringify({      type: 'answer',      answer,      roomId    }));  };    // 处理 Answer  const handleAnswer = async (answer) => {    await pcRef.current.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(answer));  };    // 处理 ICE 候选  const handleIceCandidate = async (candidate) => {    try {      await pcRef.current.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(candidate));    } catch (error) {      console.error('添加 ICE 候选失败:', error);    }  };    // 获取本地媒体流  const startLocalStream = useCallback(async (constraints = { video: true, audio: true }) => {    try {      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia(constraints);      setLocalStream(stream);            // 将本地流添加到 PeerConnection      if (!pcRef.current) {        initializePeerConnection();      }            stream.getTracks().forEach(track => {        pcRef.current.addTrack(track, stream);      });            return stream;    } catch (error) {      console.error('获取媒体流失败:', error);      throw error;    }  }, [initializePeerConnection]);    // 开始屏幕共享  const startScreenShare = useCallback(async () => {    try {      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getDisplayMedia({ video: true });            // 替换视频轨道      const videoTrack = stream.getVideoTracks()[0];      const sender = pcRef.current.getSenders().find(s => s.track?.kind === 'video');            if (sender) {        await sender.replaceTrack(videoTrack);      }            // 监听屏幕共享停止      videoTrack.onended = () => {        stopScreenShare();      };            return stream;    } catch (error) {      console.error('屏幕共享失败:', error);      throw error;    }  }, []);    // 停止屏幕共享  const stopScreenShare = useCallback(() => {    if (localStream) {      const videoTrack = localStream.getVideoTracks()[0];      const sender = pcRef.current.getSenders().find(s => s.track?.kind === 'video');            if (sender && videoTrack) {        sender.replaceTrack(videoTrack);      }    }  }, [localStream]);    // 创建 Offer  const createOffer = useCallback(async () => {    if (!pcRef.current) {      initializePeerConnection();    }        // 创建数据通道    dataChannelRef.current = pcRef.current.createDataChannel('data');    setupDataChannelListeners();        const offer = await pcRef.current.createOffer();    await pcRef.current.setLocalDescription(offer);        wsRef.current.send(JSON.stringify({      type: 'offer',      offer,      roomId    }));  }, [initializePeerConnection, roomId]);    // 切换音频  const toggleAudio = useCallback(() => {    if (localStream) {      const audioTrack = localStream.getAudioTracks()[0];      if (audioTrack) {        audioTrack.enabled = !audioTrack.enabled;        return audioTrack.enabled;      }    }    return false;  }, [localStream]);    // 切换视频  const toggleVideo = useCallback(() => {    if (localStream) {      const videoTrack = localStream.getVideoTracks()[0];      if (videoTrack) {        videoTrack.enabled = !videoTrack.enabled;        return videoTrack.enabled;      }    }    return false;  }, [localStream]);    // 发送数据  const sendData = useCallback((data) => {    if (dataChannelRef.current && dataChannelRef.current.readyState === 'open') {      dataChannelRef.current.send(data);      return true;    }    return false;  }, []);    // 挂断  const hangup = useCallback(() => {    if (localStream) {      localStream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());      setLocalStream(null);    }        if (pcRef.current) {      pcRef.current.close();      pcRef.current = null;    }        setRemoteStream(null);    setIsConnected(false);  }, [localStream]);    return {    localStream,    remoteStream,    isConnected,    connectionState,    startLocalStream,    startScreenShare,    stopScreenShare,    createOffer,    toggleAudio,    toggleVideo,    sendData,    hangup  };}// 使用示例function VideoCall({ roomId }) {  const {    localStream,    remoteStream,    isConnected,    startLocalStream,    createOffer,    toggleAudio,    toggleVideo,    hangup  } = useWebRTC('ws://localhost:8080/signaling', roomId);    const localVideoRef = useRef(null);  const remoteVideoRef = useRef(null);  const [isAudioEnabled, setIsAudioEnabled] = useState(true);  const [isVideoEnabled, setIsVideoEnabled] = useState(true);    // 设置本地视频  useEffect(() => {    if (localVideoRef.current && localStream) {      localVideoRef.current.srcObject = localStream;    }  }, [localStream]);    // 设置远程视频  useEffect(() => {    if (remoteVideoRef.current && remoteStream) {      remoteVideoRef.current.srcObject = remoteStream;    }  }, [remoteStream]);    const handleStart = async () => {    await startLocalStream();    await createOffer();  };    return (    <div className="video-call">      <div className="video-container">        <video          ref={localVideoRef}          autoPlay          muted          playsInline          className="local-video"        />        <video          ref={remoteVideoRef}          autoPlay          playsInline          className="remote-video"        />      </div>            <div className="controls">        {!localStream ? (          <button onClick={handleStart}>开始通话</button>        ) : (          <>            <button onClick={() => setIsAudioEnabled(toggleAudio())}>              {isAudioEnabled ? '🎤' : '🔇'}            </button>            <button onClick={() => setIsVideoEnabled(toggleVideo())}>              {isVideoEnabled ? '📹' : '📷'}            </button>            <button onClick={hangup} className="hangup-btn">              挂断            </button>          </>        )}      </div>            <div className="status">        {isConnected ? '🟢 已连接' : '⚪ 未连接'}      </div>    </div>  );}
