(          <button onClick={stopSharing} className="btn-stop">            停止共享          </button>        ) : (          <button onClick={startSharing} className="btn-start">            开始共享屏幕          </button>        )}      </div>    </div>  );}

多人视频会议组件 src/components/MultiPartyCall.jsximport React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';export function MultiPartyCall({ roomId, userId }) {  const [peers, setPeers] = useState(new Map());  const [localStream, setLocalStream] = useState(null);  const wsRef = useRef(null);  const peersRef = useRef(new Map());    useEffect(() => {    // 连接信令服务器    wsRef.current = new WebSocket(`ws://localhost:8080?room=${roomId}`);        wsRef.current.onmessage = async (event) => {      const message = JSON.parse(event.data);            switch (message.type) {        case 'user-joined':          await handleUserJoined(message.userId);          break;        case 'user-left':          handleUserLeft(message.userId);          break;        case 'offer':          await handleOffer(message.from, message.offer);          break;        case 'answer':          await handleAnswer(message.from, message.answer);          break;        case 'ice-candidate':          await handleIceCandidate(message.from, message.candidate);          break;        default:          break;      }    };        return () => {      // 清理所有连接      peersRef.current.forEach(pc => pc.close());      if (localStream) {        localStream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());      }      if (wsRef.current) {        wsRef.current.close();      }    };  }, [roomId]);    // 创建 PeerConnection  const createPeerConnection = (peerId) => {    const pc = new RTCPeerConnection({      iceServers: [{ urls: 'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302' }]    });        // 添加本地流    if (localStream) {      localStream.getTracks().forEach(track => {        pc.addTrack(track, localStream);      });    }        // ICE 候选    pc.onicecandidate = (event) => {      if (event.candidate) {        wsRef.current.send(JSON.stringify({          type: 'ice-candidate',          to: peerId,          candidate: event.candidate        }));      }    };        // 接收远程流    pc.ontrack = (event) => {      setPeers(prev => new Map(prev).set(peerId, {        ...prev.get(peerId),        stream: event.streams[0]      }));    };        peersRef.current.set(peerId, pc);    return pc;  };    // 处理新用户加入  const handleUserJoined = async (peerId) => {    const pc = createPeerConnection(peerId);    const offer = await pc.createOffer();    await pc.setLocalDescription(offer);        wsRef.current.send(JSON.stringify({      type: 'offer',      to: peerId,      offer    }));  };    // 处理用户离开  const handleUserLeft = (peerId) => {    const pc = peersRef.current.get(peerId);    if (pc) {      pc.close();      peersRef.current.delete(peerId);    }    setPeers(prev => {      const newPeers = new Map(prev);      newPeers.delete(peerId);      return newPeers;    });  };    // 处理 Offer  const handleOffer = async (peerId, offer) => {    const pc = createPeerConnection(peerId);    await pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(offer));    const answer = await pc.createAnswer();    await pc.setLocalDescription(answer);        wsRef.current.send(JSON.stringify({      type: 'answer',      to: peerId,      answer    }));  };    // 处理 Answer  const handleAnswer = async (peerId, answer) => {    const pc = peersRef.current.get(peerId);    if (pc) {      await pc.setRemoteDescription(new RTCSessionDescription(answer));    }  };    // 处理 ICE 候选  const handleIceCandidate = async (peerId, candidate) => {    const pc = peersRef.current.get(peerId);    if (pc) {      await pc.addIceCandidate(new RTCIceCandidate(candidate));    }  };    // 加入房间  const joinRoom = async () => {    try {      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({        video: true,        audio: true      });      setLocalStream(stream);            wsRef.current.send(JSON.stringify({        type: 'join',        roomId,        userId      }));    } catch (error) {      console.error('获取媒体流失败:', error);    }  };    return (    <div className="multi-party-call">      <h2>多人视频会议 - 房间 {roomId}</h2>            <div className="video-grid">        {/* 本地视频 */}        {localStream && (          <div className="video-item local">            <video              autoPlay              muted              playsInline              ref={el => el && (el.srcObject = localStream)}            />            <span className="label">您</span>          </div>        )}                {/* 远程视频 */}        {Array.from(peers.entries()).map(([peerId, peer]) => (          <div key={peerId} className="video-item">            <video              autoPlay              playsInline              ref={el => el && peer.stream && (el.srcObject = peer.stream)}            />            <span className="label">用户 {peerId}</span>          </div>        ))}      </div>            {!localStream && (        <button onClick={joinRoom} className="btn-join">          加入会议        </button>      )}    </div>  );}

6. 应用场景对比WebSocket 适用场景
实时聊天应用

123456789101112// 简单的文本消息传输,服务器可以记录和转发function ChatApp() {  const { sendMessage, subscribe } = useWebSocket('ws://chat.server.com');    useEffect(() => {    return subscribe('message', (msg) => {      console.log('新消息:', msg);    });  }, []);    return <div>聊天应用</div>;}


实时通知系统

12345678910// 服务器推送通知给客户端function NotificationSystem() {  const { subscribe } = useWebSocket('ws://notifications.server.com');    useEffect(() => {    return subscribe('notification', (notification) => {      showNotification(notification.title, notification.body);    });  }, []);}


股票行情/数据大盘

1234567891011// 服务器广播实时数据function StockTicker() {  const [stocks, setStocks] = useState({});  const { subscribe } = useWebSocket('ws://stocks.server.com');    useEffect(() => {    return subscribe('stock-update', (data) => {      setStocks(prev => ({ ...prev, [data.symbol]: data.price }));    });  }, []);}


协作编辑

12345678// 服务器协调多个客户端的编辑操作function CollaborativeDoc() {  const { sendMessage, subscribe } = useWebSocket('ws://collab.server.com');    const handleEdit = (change) => {    sendMessage({ type: 'edit', change });  };}

WebRTC 适用场景
视频通话应用

1234567891011// 点对点高质量音视频传输function VideoChat() {  const { localStream, remoteStream } = useWebRTC('ws://signaling.server.com', 'room1');    return (    <div>      <video srcObject={localStream} muted />      <video srcObject={remoteStream} />    </div>  );}


在线游戏

12345678// 低延迟的游戏状态同步function MultiplayerGame() {  const { sendData } = useWebRTC('ws://signaling.server.com', gameRoomId);    const updateGameState = (state) => {    sendData(JSON.stringify({ type: 'game-state', state }));  };}


P2P 文件传输

123456789101112// 大文件直接传输,不经过服务器function FileTransfer() {  const [peer, setPeer] = useState(null);    const sendFile = (file) => {    const reader = new FileReader();    reader.onload = (e) => {      peer.sendData(e.target.result);    };    reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);  };}


屏幕共享/远程协助

12345678910// 实时屏幕共享function RemoteSupport() {  const { startScreenShare } = useWebRTC('ws://signaling.server.com', supportRoomId);    return (    <button onClick={startScreenShare}>      开始屏幕共享    </button>  );}

混合使用场景12345678910111213141516171819// 同时使用 WebSocket 和 WebRTCfunction HybridVideoChat() {  // WebSocket 用于信令和文本聊天  const ws = useWebSocket('ws://chat.server.com');    // WebRTC 用于音视频  const rtc = useWebRTC('ws://signaling.server.com', 'room1');    const sendChatMessage = (text) => {    ws.sendMessage({ type: 'chat', text });  };    return (    <div>      <video srcObject={rtc.remoteStream} />      <ChatBox onSend={sendChatMessage} />    </div>  );}

7. 性能优化WebSocket 优化12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637383940414243444546// 消息批处理class BatchedWebSocket {  constructor(url, batchInterval = 100) {    this.ws = new WebSocket(url);    this.messageQueue = [];    this.batchInterval = batchInterval;        setInterval(() => {      this.flush();    }, this.batchInterval);  }    send(message) {    this.messageQueue.push(message);  }    flush() {    if (this.messageQueue.length > 0 && this.ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {      this.ws.send(JSON.stringify(this.messageQueue));      this.messageQueue = [];    }  }}// 消息压缩import pako from 'pako';function sendCompressed(ws, data) {  const json = JSON.stringify(data);  const compressed = pako.deflate(json);  ws.send(compressed);}function receiveCompressed(event) {  const decompressed = pako.inflate(event.data, { to: 'string' });  return JSON.parse(decompressed);}// 二进制协议function sendBinary(ws, data) {  const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(8);  const view = new DataView(buffer);  view.setUint32(0, data.type);  view.setUint32(4, data.value);  ws.send(buffer);}

WebRTC 优化123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748495051525354555657585960616263// 动态调整视频质量function adjustVideoQuality(pc, quality) {  const sender = pc.getSenders().find(s => s.track?.kind === 'video');    if (sender) {    const parameters = sender.getParameters();        if (!parameters.encodings) {      parameters.encodings = [{}];    }        // 根据质量设置    switch (quality) {      case 'high':        parameters.encodings[0].maxBitrate = 2500000; // 2.5 Mbps        break;      case 'medium':        parameters.encodings[0].maxBitrate = 1000000; // 1 Mbps        break;      case 'low':        parameters.encodings[0].maxBitrate = 500000;  // 500 Kbps        break;    }        sender.setParameters(parameters);  }}// 监控连接质量function monitorConnectionQuality(pc) {  setInterval(async () => {    const stats = await pc.getStats();        stats.forEach(report => {      if (report.type === 'inbound-rtp' && report.kind === 'video') {        console.log('接收码率:', report.bytesReceived);        console.log('丢包率:', report.packetsLost);        console.log('延迟:', report.jitter);                // 根据统计数据动态调整        if (report.packetsLost / report.packetsReceived > 0.1) {          adjustVideoQuality(pc, 'low');        }      }    });  }, 1000);}// SVC (可伸缩视频编码)async function enableSVC(pc) {  const sender = pc.getSenders().find(s => s.track?.kind === 'video');    if (sender) {    const parameters = sender.getParameters();    parameters.encodings = [      { rid: 'h', maxBitrate: 2000000 },      { rid: 'm', maxBitrate: 1000000, scaleResolutionDownBy: 2 },      { rid: 'l', maxBitrate: 500000, scaleResolutionDownBy: 4 }    ];        await sender.setParameters(parameters);  }}

8. 安全性考虑WebSocket 安全123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233// 使用 WSS (WebSocket Secure)const ws = new WebSocket('wss://secure.server.com');// 身份验证ws.onopen = () => {  ws.send(JSON.stringify({    type: 'auth',    token: localStorage.getItem('authToken')  }));};// 消息加密import CryptoJS from 'crypto-js';function sendEncrypted(ws, data, key) {  const encrypted = CryptoJS.AES.encrypt(    JSON.stringify(data),    key  ).toString();    ws.send(encrypted);}function receiveEncrypted(encryptedData, key) {  const decrypted = CryptoJS.AES.decrypt(encryptedData, key);  return JSON.parse(decrypted.toString(CryptoJS.enc.Utf8));}// CSRF 保护ws.onopen = () => {  const csrfToken = document.querySelector('meta[name="csrf-token"]').content;  ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'auth', csrfToken }));};

WebRTC 安全1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132// 强制使用 DTLS/SRTPconst config = {  iceServers: [    { urls: 'stun:stun.l.google.com:19302' }  ],  iceCandidatePoolSize: 10,  bundlePolicy: 'max-bundle',  rtcpMuxPolicy: 'require'};// 验证 ICE 候选function validateIceCandidate(candidate) {  // 只接受来自可信服务器的候选  const allowedServers = ['stun.l.google.com', 'turn.example.com'];    return allowedServers.some(server =>     candidate.candidate.includes(server)  );}// 加密数据通道const dataChannel = pc.createDataChannel('encrypted', {  ordered: true,  protocol: 'aes-256'});// 端到端加密function sendE2EEncrypted(dataChannel, message, publicKey) {  // 使用接收方的公钥加密  const encrypted = encryptWithPublicKey(message, publicKey);  dataChannel.send(encrypted);}

9. 调试与监控WebSocket 调试123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536// 详细日志class DebugWebSocket {  constructor(url) {    this.ws = new WebSocket(url);    this.messageLog = [];        this.ws.addEventListener('message', (event) => {      this.messageLog.push({        type: 'received',        data: event.data,        timestamp: Date.now()      });      console.log('📥 接收:', event.data);    });        const originalSend = this.ws.send.bind(this.ws);    this.ws.send = (data) => {      this.messageLog.push({        type: 'sent',        data,        timestamp: Date.now()      });      console.log('📤 发送:', data);      originalSend(data);    };  }    getMessageLog() {    return this.messageLog;  }}// Chrome DevTools// 1. Network 标签 -> WS 过滤器// 2. 查看 Messages、Frames// 3. 检查连接状态和错误

WebRTC 调试1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132333435363738394041424344454647484950515253545556575859606162636465666768// 获取详细统计信息async function getDetailedStats(pc) {  const stats = await pc.getStats();  const report = {};    stats.forEach(stat => {    if (stat.type === 'inbound-rtp') {      report.inbound = {        bytesReceived: stat.bytesReceived,        packetsReceived: stat.packetsReceived,        packetsLost: stat.packetsLost,        jitter: stat.jitter,        timestamp: stat.timestamp      };    }        if (stat.type === 'outbound-rtp') {      report.outbound = {        bytesSent: stat.bytesSent,        packetsSent: stat.packetsSent,        timestamp: stat.timestamp      };    }        if (stat.type === 'candidate-pair' && stat.state === 'succeeded') {      report.connection = {        localCandidate: stat.localCandidateId,        remoteCandidate: stat.remoteCandidateId,        currentRoundTripTime: stat.currentRoundTripTime,        availableOutgoingBitrate: stat.availableOutgoingBitrate      };    }  });    return report;}// 实时监控组件function WebRTCMonitor({ peerConnection }) {  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);    useEffect(() => {    const interval = setInterval(async () => {      const report = await getDetailedStats(peerConnection);      setStats(report);    }, 1000);        return () => clearInterval(interval);  }, [peerConnection]);    return (    <div className="rtc-monitor">      <h3>连接统计</h3>      {stats && (        <>          <div>接收: {stats.inbound?.bytesReceived} bytes</div>          <div>发送: {stats.outbound?.bytesSent} bytes</div>          <div>RTT: {stats.connection?.currentRoundTripTime}ms</div>          <div>丢包率: {            (stats.inbound?.packetsLost / stats.inbound?.packetsReceived * 100).toFixed(2)          }%</div>        </>      )}    </div>  );}// chrome://webrtc-internals/ 查看详细信息

10. 总结技术选型建议选择 WebSocket 当:

需要客户端-服务器通信
服务器需要记录和处理所有消息
需要向多个客户端广播
实现相对简单的实时功能
需要保证消息顺序和可靠性

选择 WebRTC 当:

需要音视频通信
延迟要求极低(<100ms)
可以接受点对点架构
需要传输大量数据
减轻服务器带宽压力

混合使用当:

视频会议 + 文字聊天
需要信令服务器 + P2P 数据传输
复杂的实时协作应用

最佳实践
WebSocket

使用 WSS 加密连接
实现心跳和自动重连
消息队列处理离线情况
考虑消息压缩


WebRTC

合理配置 STUN/TURN 服务器
监控连接质量并动态调整
实现优雅的回退机制
注意跨浏览器兼容性


React 集成

使用 Hook 封装逻辑
Context 管理全局连接
正确处理组件生命周期
避免内存泄漏



通过合理选择和使用 WebSocket 与 WebRTC,可以构建高性能、低延迟的实时 Web 应用,为用户提供流畅的交互体验。

title: Service Worker 深入理解与实践
Web Worker 详解：JavaScript 多线程编程实战
content:
Web Worker 详解：JavaScript 多线程编程实战一、Web Worker 是什么？背景与动机JavaScript 是单线程执行的，所有代码都在主线程运行。这意味着：

密集计算会阻塞 UI：比如大量数据处理、复杂算法计算
长时间任务导致页面卡顿：用户无法交互，体验很差
无法充分利用多核 CPU：现代设备多是多核处理器

Web Worker 的出现就是为了解决这些问题。
核心概念Web Worker 是运行在后台线程的 JavaScript，它：

独立于主线程执行
不会阻塞 UI 渲染
无法访问 DOM
通过消息机制与主线程通信
可以执行密集计算任务

形象比喻：主线程像前台接待，Worker 像后台工作人员。前台负责与用户交互，后台负责处理耗时任务，互不干扰。

二、Web Worker 的类型1. Dedicated Worker（专用 Worker）最常用的 Worker 类型，一对一关系，只能被创建它的脚本使用。
123456789101112131415161718// main.js - 主线程const worker = new Worker('worker.js');// 发送消息给 Workerworker.postMessage({ type: 'calculate', data: [1, 2, 3] });// 接收 Worker 的消息worker.addEventListener('message', (event) => {  console.log('收到结果:', event.data);});// 错误处理worker.addEventListener('error', (error) => {  console.error('Worker 错误:', error.message);});// 终止 Workerworker.terminate();

123456789101112// worker.js - Worker 线程self.addEventListener('message', (event) => {  const { type, data } = event.data;    if (type === 'calculate') {    // 执行耗时计算    const result = data.reduce((sum, num) => sum + num, 0);        // 发送结果回主线程    self.postMessage({ result });  }});


2. Shared Worker（共享 Worker）可以被多个脚本共享，比如多个标签页、iframe 可以连接到同一个 Shared Worker。
12345678910// main.jsconst worker = new SharedWorker('shared-worker.js');worker.port.start();worker.port.postMessage({ type: 'connect', id: 'page1' });worker.port.addEventListener('message', (event) => {  console.log('收到消息:', event.data);});

123456789101112131415161718// shared-worker.jsconst connections = [];self.addEventListener('connect', (event) => {  const port = event.ports[0];  connections.push(port);    port.addEventListener('message', (e) => {    // 广播给所有连接    connections.forEach(p => {      if (p !== port) {        p.postMessage(e.data);      }    });  });    port.start();});

应用场景：

多标签页实时同步
共享 WebSocket 连接
跨页面状态管理


3. Service Worker（服务 Worker）这是最强大的 Worker 类型，主要用于 PWA（渐进式 Web 应用）。
Service Worker 的详细内容会在另一篇文章中专门介绍，这里只简单提及：

拦截网络请求
实现离线缓存
推送通知
后台同步


三、Web Worker 的核心 API主线程 API123456789101112131415161718192021// 1. 创建 Workerconst worker = new Worker('worker.js', {  name: 'my-worker',  // Worker 名称（可选）  type: 'classic'     // 'classic' 或 'module'（ES Module）});// 2. 发送消息worker.postMessage(data);// 3. 接收消息worker.onmessage = (event) => {  console.log(event.data);};// 4. 错误处理worker.onerror = (error) => {  console.error(error.message, error.filename, error.lineno);};// 5. 终止 Workerworker.terminate();


Worker 线程 API1234567891011121314151617181920212223// 1. 接收主线程消息self.onmessage = (event) => {  console.log('收到:', event.data);};// 或者self.addEventListener('message', (event) => {  console.log('收到:', event.data);});// 2. 发送消息给主线程self.postMessage(data);// 3. 导入其他脚本importScripts('utils.js', 'math.js');// 4. 关闭自己self.close();// 5. 错误处理self.onerror = (error) => {  console.error('Worker 内部错误:', error);};


Worker 的限制Worker 环境不能访问：

document、window 对象
DOM 操作
某些 Web API（如 localStorage）
父页面的全局变量

Worker 环境可以访问：

XMLHttpRequest、fetch
setTimeout、setInterval
IndexedDB
WebSocket
console
navigator（部分）
location（只读）


四、消息传递机制1. 结构化克隆（Structured Clone）默认情况下，数据通过结构化克隆传递，会复制数据。
1234567891011// 主线程const data = {  name: 'John',  age: 30,  hobbies: ['reading', 'coding']};worker.postMessage(data);// 修改原始数据不会影响 Workerdata.age = 31;

可以克隆的类型：

基本类型（number、string、boolean）
Object、Array
Date、RegExp
Map、Set
Blob、File、ImageData
ArrayBuffer、TypedArray

不能克隆的类型：

函数
DOM 节点
Symbol
包含循环引用的对象（会报错）


2. 可转移对象（Transferable Objects）对于大型数据（如 ArrayBuffer），可以使用转移而不是复制，性能更好。
12345678// 主线程const buffer = new ArrayBuffer(1024 * 1024); // 1MB// 转移所有权给 Workerworker.postMessage({ buffer }, [buffer]);// 此后主线程不能再使用 bufferconsole.log(buffer.byteLength); // 0

12345678910// worker.jsself.onmessage = (event) => {  const { buffer } = event.data;    // Worker 现在拥有 buffer  console.log(buffer.byteLength); // 1048576    // 处理完后转移回主线程  self.postMessage({ buffer }, [buffer]);};

可转移的类型：

ArrayBuffer
MessagePort
ImageBitmap
OffscreenCanvas

优势：

零拷贝，性能极高
适合大型二进制数据

注意：

转移后原线程无法访问
所有权转移，不是共享


3. SharedArrayBuffer（共享内存）多个线程共享同一块内存，真正的并发编程。
123456789101112// 主线程const sab = new SharedArrayBuffer(1024);const view = new Int32Array(sab);view[0] = 100;worker.postMessage({ sab });// 主线程和 Worker 都可以修改同一块内存setTimeout(() => {  console.log(view[0]); // Worker 修改后的值}, 1000);

12345678// worker.jsself.onmessage = (event) => {  const { sab } = event.data;  const view = new Int32Array(sab);    // 修改共享内存  view[0] = 200;};

注意：

需要配合 Atomics API 避免竞态条件
需要服务器设置特定的 CORS 头
有安全风险，默认可能被禁用


五、实际应用场景场景 1：大数据处理问题： 处理大量数据（如 CSV 解析、JSON 处理）会阻塞主线程。
解决方案： 在 Worker 中处理数据。
12345678910111213// 主线程const worker = new Worker('data-processor.js');fetch('/api/large-data.json')  .then(res => res.json())  .then(data => {    worker.postMessage({ type: 'process', data });  });worker.onmessage = (event) => {  const { result } = event.data;  updateUI(result); // 更新界面};

1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526// data-processor.jsself.onmessage = (event) => {  const { type, data } = event.data;    if (type === 'process') {    // 复杂的数据转换    const result = data      .filter(item => item.active)      .map(item => ({        ...item,        calculated: heavyCalculation(item)      }))      .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);        self.postMessage({ result });  }};function heavyCalculation(item) {  // 密集计算  let sum = 0;  for (let i = 0; i < 1000000; i++) {    sum += Math.sqrt(item.value * i);  }  return sum;}


场景 2：图像处理问题： 图像滤镜、压缩等操作耗时长。
解决方案： 在 Worker 中处理图像数据。
12345678910111213141516171819// 主线程const worker = new Worker('image-processor.js');const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');// 获取图像数据const imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);// 发送给 Worker 处理worker.postMessage({  type: 'applyFilter',  imageData,  filter: 'grayscale'}, [imageData.data.buffer]); // 转移 ArrayBufferworker.onmessage = (event) => {  const { imageData } = event.data;  ctx.putImageData(imageData, 0, 0);};

12345678910111213141516171819// image-processor.jsself.onmessage = (event) => {  const { type, imageData, filter } = event.data;    if (type === 'applyFilter') {    const data = imageData.data;        if (filter === 'grayscale') {      for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {        const avg = (data[i] + data[i + 1] + data[i + 2]) / 3;        data[i] = avg;     // R        data[i + 1] = avg; // G        data[i + 2] = avg; // B      }    }        self.postMessage({ imageData }, [data.buffer]);  }};


场景 3：复杂计算（加密、压缩）1234567891011121314151617// 主线程const worker = new Worker('crypto-worker.js');document.getElementById('encrypt-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {  const text = document.getElementById('input').value;    worker.postMessage({    type: 'encrypt',    text,    key: 'my-secret-key'  });});worker.onmessage = (event) => {  const { encrypted } = event.data;  document.getElementById('output').value = encrypted;};

123456789101112// crypto-worker.jsimportScripts('crypto-js.min.js'); // 导入加密库self.onmessage = (event) => {  const { type, text, key } = event.data;    if (type === 'encrypt') {    // 执行加密（耗时操作）    const encrypted = CryptoJS.AES.encrypt(text, key).toString();    self.postMessage({ encrypted });  }};


场景 4：实时数据流处理问题： WebSocket 接收大量实时数据，主线程处理会卡顿。
解决方案： Worker 处理数据流。
1234567891011121314151617// 主线程const worker = new Worker('stream-processor.js');const ws = new WebSocket('wss://example.com/stream');ws.onmessage = (event) => {  // 转发给 Worker 处理  worker.postMessage({ type: 'data', data: event.data });};worker.onmessage = (event) => {  const { type, processed } = event.data;    if (type === 'batch') {    // 批量更新 UI    updateChart(processed);  }};

12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728// stream-processor.jslet buffer = [];let lastFlush = Date.now();self.onmessage = (event) => {  const { type, data } = event.data;    if (type === 'data') {    buffer.push(JSON.parse(data));        // 每 100ms 或缓冲区满时批量处理    if (buffer.length >= 100 || Date.now() - lastFlush > 100) {      const processed = processBuffer(buffer);      self.postMessage({ type: 'batch', processed });            buffer = [];      lastFlush = Date.now();    }  }};function processBuffer(data) {  // 聚合、计算、过滤  return data.reduce((acc, item) => {    // 复杂的聚合逻辑    return acc;  }, {});}


六、在 React 中使用 Web Worker1. 基础封装1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132333435// useWorker.js - 自定义 Hookimport { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';export function useWorker(workerUrl) {  const workerRef = useRef(null);  const [data, setData] = useState(null);  const [error, setError] = useState(null);  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);    useEffect(() => {    workerRef.current = new Worker(workerUrl);        workerRef.current.onmessage = (event) => {      setData(event.data);      setLoading(false);    };        workerRef.current.onerror = (error) => {      setError(error.message);      setLoading(false);    };        return () => {      workerRef.current?.terminate();    };  }, [workerUrl]);    const postMessage = (message) => {    setLoading(true);    setError(null);    workerRef.current?.postMessage(message);  };    return { data, error, loading, postMessage };}

使用示例：
1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526// DataProcessor.jsximport { useWorker } from './useWorker';function DataProcessor() {  const { data, loading, postMessage } = useWorker('/workers/processor.js');    const handleProcess = () => {    const largeData = generateLargeData();    postMessage({ type: 'process', data: largeData });  };    return (    <div>      <button onClick={handleProcess} disabled={loading}>        {loading ? '处理中...' : '处理数据'}      </button>            {data && (        <div>          <h3>处理结果:</h3>          <pre>{JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)}</pre>        </div>      )}    </div>  );}


2. Comlink 库简化通信Comlink 是一个让 Worker 通信像调用普通函数一样简单的库。
1npm install comlink

123456789101112131415// worker.jsimport { expose } from 'comlink';const api = {  async processData(data) {    // 处理数据    return data.map(item => item * 2);  },    async calculateSum(numbers) {    return numbers.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);  }};expose(api);

123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233// App.jsximport { wrap } from 'comlink';import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';function App() {  const [worker, setWorker] = useState(null);  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);    useEffect(() => {    const w = new Worker(new URL('./worker.js', import.meta.url), {      type: 'module'    });        setWorker(wrap(w));        return () => w.terminate();  }, []);    const handleCalculate = async () => {    if (worker) {      // 像调用普通异步函数一样使用      const sum = await worker.calculateSum([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]);      setResult(sum);    }  };    return (    <div>      <button onClick={handleCalculate}>计算</button>      {result && <p>结果: {result}</p>}    </div>  );}


3. 在 Vite/Create React App 中使用Vite：
12345// 直接导入 Worker 文件const worker = new Worker(  new URL('./worker.js', import.meta.url),  { type: 'module' });

Create React App：
1234// 使用 ?worker 后缀import Worker from './worker?worker';const worker = new Worker();

Webpack 5：
123const worker = new Worker(  new URL('./worker.js', import.meta.url));


4. React 实战：图片压缩组件123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748495051525354555657585960616263646566// ImageCompressor.jsximport { useState } from 'react';import { useWorker } from './useWorker';function ImageCompressor() {  const [preview, setPreview] = useState(null);  const { data, loading, postMessage } = useWorker('/workers/image-compressor.js');    const handleFileChange = async (e) => {    const file = e.target.files[0];    if (!file) return;        // 预览原图    setPreview(URL.createObjectURL(file));        // 读取文件    const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();        // 发送给 Worker 压缩    postMessage({      type: 'compress',      buffer: arrayBuffer,      quality: 0.8    }, [arrayBuffer]);  };    const handleDownload = () => {    if (data?.blob) {      const url = URL.createObjectURL(data.blob);      const a = document.createElement('a');      a.href = url;      a.download = 'compressed.jpg';      a.click();    }  };    return (    <div className="compressor">      <input        type="file"        accept="image/*"        onChange={handleFileChange}      />            {preview && (        <div className="preview">          <h3>原图</h3>          <img src={preview} alt="原图" />        </div>      )}            {loading && <div>压缩中...</div>}            {data && (        <div className="result">          <h3>压缩后</h3>          <img src={URL.createObjectURL(data.blob)} alt="压缩后" />          <p>原始大小: {data.originalSize}</p>          <p>压缩后: {data.compressedSize}</p>          <p>压缩率: {data.ratio}%</p>          <button onClick={handleDownload}>下载</button>        </div>      )}    </div>  );}

123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233// workers/image-compressor.jsself.onmessage = async (event) => {  const { type, buffer, quality } = event.data;    if (type === 'compress') {    // 将 ArrayBuffer 转换为 Blob    const blob = new Blob([buffer]);        // 创建 ImageBitmap    const imageBitmap = await createImageBitmap(blob);        // 使用 OffscreenCanvas 压缩    const canvas = new OffscreenCanvas(      imageBitmap.width,      imageBitmap.height    );    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');    ctx.drawImage(imageBitmap, 0, 0);        // 压缩    const compressedBlob = await canvas.convertToBlob({      type: 'image/jpeg',      quality    });        self.postMessage({      blob: compressedBlob,      originalSize: buffer.byteLength,      compressedSize: compressedBlob.size,      ratio: ((1 - compressedBlob.size / buffer.byteLength) * 100).toFixed(2)    });  }};


七、PWA 中的应用1. 后台数据同步在 PWA 中，可以使用 Worker 在后台同步数据，即使用户关闭了页面。
123456789101112// 主应用if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {  navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js');}// 创建 Worker 处理后台任务const syncWorker = new Worker('/workers/sync-worker.js');// 当网络恢复时同步数据window.addEventListener('online', () => {  syncWorker.postMessage({ type: 'sync' });});

1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526// workers/sync-worker.jsself.onmessage = async (event) => {  const { type } = event.data;    if (type === 'sync') {    // 从 IndexedDB 读取离线数据    const offlineData = await getOfflineData();        // 批量上传到服务器    for (const item of offlineData) {      try {        await fetch('/api/sync', {          method: 'POST',          body: JSON.stringify(item)        });                // 上传成功，删除本地数据        await deleteOfflineData(item.id);      } catch (error) {        console.error('同步失败:', error);      }    }        self.postMessage({ type: 'sync-complete' });  }};


2. 离线数据处理1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526// 主应用const dataWorker = new Worker('/workers/data-worker.js');// 保存数据到 IndexedDBfunction saveData(data) {  dataWorker.postMessage({    type: 'save',    data  });}// 查询数据function queryData(filters) {  return new Promise((resolve) => {    dataWorker.postMessage({      type: 'query',      filters    });        dataWorker.onmessage = (event) => {      if (event.data.type === 'query-result') {        resolve(event.data.results);      }    };  });}

12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637383940414243444546474849505152535455565758// workers/data-worker.js// 在 Worker 中操作 IndexedDBlet db;// 打开数据库const request = indexedDB.open('MyDatabase', 1);request.onsuccess = (event) => {  db = event.target.result;};request.onupgradeneeded = (event) => {  db = event.target.result;    if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('items')) {    const store = db.createObjectStore('items', { keyPath: 'id' });    store.createIndex('category', 'category', { unique: false });  }};self.onmessage = async (event) => {  const { type, data, filters } = event.data;    if (type === 'save') {    const transaction = db.transaction(['items'], 'readwrite');    const store = transaction.objectStore('items');    store.add(data);        transaction.oncomplete = () => {      self.postMessage({ type: 'save-complete' });    };  }    if (type === 'query') {    const transaction = db.transaction(['items'], 'readonly');    const store = transaction.objectStore('items');    const results = [];        const request = store.openCursor();        request.onsuccess = (event) => {      const cursor = event.target.result;            if (cursor) {        if (matchFilters(cursor.value, filters)) {          results.push(cursor.value);        }        cursor.continue();      } else {        // 遍历完成        self.postMessage({          type: 'query-result',          results        });      }    };  }};


3. 推送通知处理1234567891011121314151617181920212223// 主应用const notificationWorker = new Worker('/workers/notification-worker.js');// 请求通知权限async function requestNotificationPermission() {  const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();    if (permission === 'granted') {    notificationWorker.postMessage({ type: 'start-monitoring' });  }}// Worker 处理通知逻辑notificationWorker.onmessage = (event) => {  const { type, notification } = event.data;    if (type === 'show-notification') {    new Notification(notification.title, {      body: notification.body,      icon: notification.icon    });  }};


八、性能优化与最佳实践1. Worker 池（Worker Pool）对于频繁的任务，创建 Worker 池复用 Worker。
12345678910111213141516171819202122232425262728293031323334353637383940414243444546474849505152535455565758596061626364656667686970class WorkerPool {  constructor(workerUrl, poolSize = 4) {    this.workers = [];    this.taskQueue = [];    this.activeWorkers = new Set();        // 创建 Worker 池    for (let i = 0; i < poolSize; i++) {      const worker = new Worker(workerUrl);      worker.id = i;      this.workers.push(worker);    }  }    async execute(data) {    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {      const task = { data, resolve, reject };            // 尝试获取空闲 Worker      const worker = this.getIdleWorker();            if (worker) {        this.runTask(worker, task);      } else {        // 加入队列等待        this.taskQueue.push(task);      }    });  }    getIdleWorker() {    return this.workers.find(w => !this.activeWorkers.has(w));  }    runTask(worker, task) {    this.activeWorkers.add(worker);        worker.onmessage = (event) => {      task.resolve(event.data);      this.activeWorkers.delete(worker);            // 处理队列中的下一个任务      if (this.taskQueue.length > 0) {        const nextTask = this.taskQueue.shift();        this.runTask(worker, nextTask);      }    };        worker.onerror = (error) => {      task.reject(error);      this.activeWorkers.delete(worker);    };        worker.postMessage(task.data);  }    terminate() {    this.workers.forEach(w => w.terminate());  }}// 使用const pool = new WorkerPool('/worker.js', 4);// 并发执行多个任务const tasks = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8].map(n =>   pool.execute({ type: 'calculate', value: n }));const results = await Promise.all(tasks);


2. 动态导入 Worker按需加载 Worker，减少初始加载时间。
12345678910111213141516let worker = null;async function getWorker() {  if (!worker) {    // 动态导入    const WorkerModule = await import('./worker.js?worker');    worker = new WorkerModule.default();  }  return worker;}// 使用async function processData(data) {  const worker = await getWorker();  worker.postMessage(data);}


3. 内联 Worker将 Worker 代码内联在主脚本中，避免额外的 HTTP 请求。
123456789101112131415161718function createInlineWorker(fn) {  const blob = new Blob(    [`(${fn.toString()})()`],    { type: 'application/javascript' }  );    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);  return new Worker(url);}// 使用const worker = createInlineWorker(() => {  self.onmessage = (event) => {    // Worker 逻辑    const result = event.data * 2;    self.postMessage(result);  };});


4. 错误处理与容错1234567891011121314151617181920212223242526272829303132333435363738394041class SafeWorker {  constructor(workerUrl, options = {}) {    this.url = workerUrl;    this.maxRetries = options.maxRetries || 3;    this.retryDelay = options.retryDelay || 1000;    this.worker = null;    this.init();  }    init() {    this.worker = new Worker(this.url);        this.worker.onerror = (error) => {      console.error('Worker 错误:', error);      this.restart();    };  }    async restart() {    console.log('重启 Worker...');    this.worker?.terminate();        await new Promise(resolve =>       setTimeout(resolve, this.retryDelay)    );        this.init();  }    postMessage(data) {    if (this.worker) {      this.worker.postMessage(data);    } else {      console.error('Worker 不可用');    }  }    terminate() {    this.worker?.terminate();  }}


5. 监控 Worker 性能123456789101112131415161718192021222324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445464748class MonitoredWorker {  constructor(workerUrl) {    this.worker = new Worker(workerUrl);    this.metrics = {      messagesSent: 0,      messagesReceived: 0,      errors: 0,      averageResponseTime: 0,      responseTimes: []    };        this.setupMonitoring();  }    setupMonitoring() {    this.worker.addEventListener('message', (event) => {      this.metrics.messagesReceived++;            if (event.data._timestamp) {        const responseTime = Date.now() - event.data._timestamp;        this.metrics.responseTimes.push(responseTime);                // 计算平均响应时间（最近 100 次）        const recent = this.metrics.responseTimes.slice(-100);        this.metrics.averageResponseTime =           recent.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / recent.length;      }    });        this.worker.addEventListener('error', () => {      this.metrics.errors++;    });  }    postMessage(data) {    this.metrics.messagesSent++;        // 添加时间戳用于计算响应时间    this.worker.postMessage({      ...data,      _timestamp: Date.now()    });  }    getMetrics() {    return { ...this.metrics };  }}


九、调试技巧1. Chrome DevTools 调试在 Chrome 中打开 DevTools：

Sources 面板 → 可以看到所有 Worker 脚本
设置断点 → 在 Worker 代码中设置断点
Console → Worker 的 console.log 会显示在这里
Performance 面板 → 可以分析 Worker 的性能

2. Worker 日志封装123456789101112131415161718192021// worker.jsconst log = {  info: (...args) => {    self.postMessage({      type: '_log',      level: 'info',      message: args    });  },  error: (...args) => {    self.postMessage({      type: '_log',      level: 'error',      message: args    });  }};// 使用log.info('Worker 启动');log.error('处理失败', error);

1234567891011// 主线程worker.onmessage = (event) => {  if (event.data.type === '_log') {    const { level, message } = event.data;    console[level]('[Worker]', ...message);    return;  }    // 正常消息处理  handleMessage(event.data);};


十、总结Web Worker 的核心要点
解决问题：避免长任务阻塞主线程，提升用户体验
消息机制：通过 postMessage 和 onmessage 通信
数据传递：支持结构化克隆、转移对象、共享内存
环境限制：不能访问 DOM，但可以使用大部分 Web API
性能优化：Worker 池、按需加载、内联 Worker

适用场景
大数据处理
图像/视频处理
复杂计算（加密、压缩）
实时数据流处理
PWA 后台任务

React 中的应用
封装自定义 Hook
使用 Comlink 简化通信
配合现代构建工具
实现离线功能

最佳实践
合理使用 Worker 池
注意内存管理和生命周期
做好错误处理和容错
监控性能指标
选择合适的数据传递方式

Web Worker 是前端性能优化的重要工具，掌握它能让你的应用更流畅、更强大！
